Fit a Bayesian model using the brms package with default settings

fit_brms_model.Rd

Ported from aphantasiaEmotions so both packages fit models the same way. iterations is post-warmup draws per chain, not a total.

Usage

fit_brms_model(
  ...,
  chains = 4,
  iterations = 2000,
  warmup = 1000,
  cores = chains,
  refresh = 500,
  backend = "rstan",
  file_refit = "on_change",
  file_compress = "xz",
  sample_prior = FALSE,
  save_pars = NULL,
  adapt_delta = 0.95,
  max_treedepth = 10,
  seed = 667
)

Arguments

...

Arguments passed to brms::brm(), such as formula, data, family, priors, file.

chains

Number of MCMC chains. Default 4.

iterations

Post-warmup iterations per chain. Default 2000.

warmup

Warmup iterations per chain. Default 1000.

cores

Cores for parallel processing. Default chains.

refresh

Frequency of progress updates. Default 500.

backend

Backend for fitting. Default "rstan" (cmdstanr conflicts with pkgdown).

file_refit

Condition for refitting a cached model. Default "on_change".

file_compress

Compression for the saved model. Default "xz".

sample_prior

Whether to draw prior samples. Default FALSE.

save_pars

Parameters to save. Default NULL.

adapt_delta

Target acceptance rate. Default 0.95.

max_treedepth

Maximum treedepth. Default 10.

seed

Random seed. Default 667.

Value

A fitted brms model object.
